state.description: The text (or JSON, as a string) describing the situation to evaluate -- e.g. a ticket body, a device log excerpt, parsed pyATS/show-command output. Passed to TypeSafe's Jev model as-is, unmodified.

questions.description: A JSON-encoded object mapping a question name to its definition, matching TypeSafe's System One question schema. Each definition needs "type" (one of "choice", "score", "noul") and "instructions" describing what to evaluate; a "choice" question also needs "criteria" (object mapping each option name to a description of when to pick it). Example: {"urgent": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "Is this asking for money back?"}, "team": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which team should handle this?", "criteria": {"billing": "payment or invoice issues", "technical": "errors or outages"}}}. Multiple questions in one call are evaluated in parallel against the same state.
